title: The Paradox of Stochasticity: Limited Creativity and Computational Decoupling in Temperature-Varied LLM Outputs of Structured Fictional Data.

bias_targets.methodology: Automated generation of structured fictional person data (first names, last names, birthdates) across multiple LLMs and temperature settings, followed by frequency distribution analysis to measure the models' propensity to default to culturally dominant name archetypes (e.g., 'John Doe', 'Jane Smith').
